title: Add human bot profiles for sparring partners

source.notes: Original feature inspired by Discord discussion. No GUI chess app has human-like bot profiles.

description: 12 built-in bots (600-2200 Elo) with names, avatars, and playing styles. Each profile maps to Stockfish UCI options (Skill Level, UCI_Elo, Contempt). Includes random profile generator, custom bot editor with emoji picker/Elo slider/aggression slider, and gallery modal. Human-like move delay with jitter in the Rust backend. New 3-way opponent selector: Human / Bot / Engine.
notes: Bot profiles are purely frontend — flattened to PlayerConfig::Engine at game start
Rust backend only change: min_move_time_ms field on PlayerConfig::Engine with shutdown-aware jittered delay
Elo <1320 uses Skill Level (SF UCI_Elo floor is 1320), Elo 1320+ uses UCI_LimitStrength + UCI_Elo
Move delay varies by moveSpeed profile and Elo (500ms-8000ms base with +/-30% jitter)
Custom profiles persisted via savedBotProfilesAtom in localStorage
specta generates min_move_time_ms as snake_case (enum rename_all only affects variant names) — use u32 not u64 to avoid bigint

in_scope: 12 built-in profiles across Elo ranges with personality descriptions
Random profile generator with curated name/emoji/style pools
UCI mapping function (Skill Level, UCI_Elo, UCI_LimitStrength, Contempt)
Move time humanization with jittered delay in Rust backend
Bot gallery modal with Gallery and My Bots tabs
Bot editor form for custom profiles
Persistence atoms for saved profiles and last-used profile
out_of_scope: Time management simulation (variable thinking time per move complexity)
Bot profile avatars beyond emoji (SVG illustrations)
Player skill tracking to auto-calibrate bot difficulty

done_criteria: 3-way Human/Bot/Engine selector works in opponent form
All 12 built-in bots selectable from gallery
Random bot generation produces valid profiles
Custom bot creation, save, and delete works
Bot games use correct UCI options for Elo range
Move delay feels natural in untimed games
No delay applied when time controls are active
Board orientation correct when playing as black vs bot
